2. Pine Crossing, from Pree's message on Jun 9 2026 at 10:48 AM. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. Wichita store, which I marked as "possible." In her Jul 2 2025 message, Pree mentions a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher in the room hosting the Marrow office hours. The message never says the store is Marrow's, so I asked her to confirm.

I also told her that her Jun 9 message mentions three tracker rows marked only "waiting," but the channel doesn't say which stores those are. The Tulsa hub and Door 6 belong to the Tansley Parcel and Tansleigh Packaging accounts, so I left them out.

I didn't search the knowledge brain, because its results include channels Pree can't see. I offered to check the account files for more sites if she wants.
